hardening: Case-folded duplicate request headers fail closed instead of being silently overwritten
Non-enumerable and symbol request-header properties fail closed
JSON array and scalar responses fail closed; the adapter accepts JSON objects only
Projection of a literal __proto__ field preserves an ordinary result prototype
Receipt validation enforces PASS/FAIL_CLOSED semantic relationships after receipt-root recomputation
Known Node environment and CLI proxy switches fail closed before transport
Default runtime uses node:https.request with a per-request explicit Agent instead of global fetch
The native path remains successful when node:http.setGlobalProxyFromEnv points at an unavailable loopback proxy
boundary: This is local candidate evidence for one TINP-owned read-only HTTP policy adapter; known proxy environment variables and Node environment-proxy switches fail closed, and the default native path bypasses the standard Node global proxy Agent in a bounded check. It does not prove immunity to arbitrary runtime monkey-patching or custom injected transports. It does not prove independent third-party interoperability, cross-host transport, production credentials, or general network authority.
